title: P6-10: Threat Intelligence: copy the content cross-account and prove fidelity against the baseline
description:
## Goal
The two riskiest unknowns of the shared-root cutover are proven on a throwaway name before any real hostname moves, and the TI staging site is checked on its default URL.

## Context (FACT)
- anth.us is shared by SIX associations in legacy (Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy, apricity, babulus, tactus, primus/plexus, TI dzefa11i80jyq). They share the single legacy validation CNAME `_61eb973a5871f1d267087bf984ea1d49.anth.us` (one deterministic token per account+domain). The NEW account has its own token, so a second CNAME `_<new>.anth.us` is needed and must coexist with `_61eb...`.
- Unproven: (1) a second account can create an association for the shared root anth.us with a different prefix while legacy associations exist; (2) removing that association touches nothing in the zone or the other apps. (The same-prefix conflict, R1, is only provable at the real cutover or from PPY-52d455.)
- A rehearsal in papyrus-staging would need a CDK bootstrap, an OIDC provider, a GitHub App authorization, a Google client and a full backend build, and it still could not hold the real hostnames. The throwaway-prefix test on the production TI app proves the same unknowns for the cost of three DNS records. papyrus-staging stays unused.
- An out-of-band association on the new app would make the later CloudFormation `AWS::Amplify::Domain` for anth.us fail (one association per domain per app): the rehearsal association MUST be deleted before P6-12.

## Exact steps
1. Pre: P6-08 done; P6-01 baselines current (zone, five other associations, Anth.us hashes and cert).
2. Ryan yes: `aws amplify create-domain-association --app-id <new TI app> --domain-name anth.us --no-enable-auto-sub-domain --sub-domain-settings prefix=p6-rehearsal,branchName=main` (production profile). Read `certificateVerificationDNSRecord` and the subdomain dnsRecord.
3. Ryan yes, legacy zone write: CREATE the new validation CNAME (TTL 300). Wait for AVAILABLE. Do NOT create the `p6-rehearsal` host record (nothing needs to resolve).
4. Prove: validation tokens differ and both CNAMEs coexist; the new cert's SAN; `list-domain-associations` for the other five apps and `get-domain-association` for d2hbn1ig6nqyhy are identical to the P6-01 files; zone diff = only the new validation CNAME; Anth.us hashes and cert serial unchanged.
5. Delete the rehearsal association (production profile); re-diff the zone and the five associations (identical again, except the kept validation CNAME, which stays forever for certificate renewal).
6. Staging checks on the default URL of the staging branch (stack-created): `node scripts/check-staging-guards.mjs <url> staging`, anonymous GET redirects to /newsroom with no loop, noindex and robots disallow, STAGING banner, editor sees a draft that is 404 on production, non-editor 403, production branch has no staging-only variables (names).

## Acceptance checks
- The proofs in step 4 and 5 recorded; staging checks green; no association other than none remains on the new TI app.

## Rollback
Delete the association and the validation CNAME (`DELETE` with the exact saved values). Nothing live is touched.

## Needs Ryan
Yes for the association and the DNS record (a write in the SHARED zone: the plan above lists exactly which names), staging sign-ins.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under /Users/home/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
right_now_summary: The team will test cross-account TI copying, verify it against baselines, check staging, and remove the test
